title: Spec artifact
description: Produced by the Architect in SPEC. States what the change must achieve and, critically, what it must not touch. Ambiguity is declared rather than resolved: an Architect that guesses produces a plan that verifies the wrong thing.

goal.description: What the change must achieve, in the requester's terms.

observable.description: How this criterion could be observed by executing something. A criterion with no observable form cannot become a Task with an oracle.

affected_surfaces.description: Paths expected to change. A hint for retrieval ranking, not a constraint on the patch.

non_goals.description: What this change explicitly does not do. Prevents scope creep across Tasks.

open_questions.description: Decisions the Architect could not infer. A non-empty list with ambiguity_score above the Project threshold routes the Run to AWAIT_HUMAN rather than guessing (FR-029).

ambiguity_score.description: The Architect's assessment of unresolved ambiguity. Compared against the Project threshold by the orchestrator; the Architect does not decide the routing.
